caption: Cristo Redentore, Maratea
composition: White Christ statue on the cliff above the Tyrrhenian town · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From across the water the white statue of Christ with outstretched arms stands on its rocky pinnacle at the center top of the frame, with the whitewashed houses of Maratea cascading down the green hillside to the right. The deep blue Tyrrhenian Sea fills the left, and forested mountains close the far horizon. At 08:31 the morning sun lights the statue and the town brightly against the darker cliffs.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Cristo Redentore in Maratea under clear morning light
